note: Documentation only - no simulation behaviour changes. The user guide now explains offline use: the first visit downloads the whole app (about 6 MB across 24 files) and every visit after runs from that copy, no install required; what the four network requests are and how each degrades offline; and what clearing your browser data costs - three actions, three answers, only one of which touches your designs. Corrects four stale guide claims, the most important being that thrust curves download on demand: they have been bundled since v0.107, so a motor flies offline whether or not you flew it online. Says plainly that offline use on iOS/iPadOS is untested.
